description: This file is a shell script that sets up, executes, and tests various scenarios of Git push operations with signing, including push certificates, GPG, SSH, and related configurations. It contains multiple test cases for signed and unsigned pushes, error cases, and verification of push certificates and signatures.

methods.name: prepare_dst
methods.description: Prepares the destination repository by removing existing 'dst' directory, creating a new repository, and pushing several branches to different refs.
